name: Dromite
description: Small monstrous humanoid with insectoid chitin, elemental resistance, scent, and psionic energy ray. LA +1.

ability.name: Chitin Energy Resistance 5
ability.description: Resistance 5 to one energy type (cold, electricity, fire, or sonic), chosen at character creation. Determines caste. Stacks with other energy resistance.

ability.name: Naturally Psionic
ability.description: Gain 1 bonus power point at 1st level. Does not grant manifesting.

ability.name: Scent
ability.description: Detect opponents by scent within 30 ft. (60 ft. upwind, 15 ft. downwind). Can pinpoint within 5 ft.

name: Duergar (Gray Dwarf)
description: Medium humanoid (dwarf). Subterranean psionic dwarves with darkvision 120 ft., immunities to paralysis/phantasms/poison, stonecunning, and light sensitivity. LA +1.

ability.name: Darkvision 120 ft.
ability.description: Duergar can see in the dark up to 120 feet.

ability.name: Magic Resistance
ability.description: +2 racial bonus on saving throws against spells and spell-like effects.

ability.name: Stability
ability.description: +4 racial bonus on ability checks to resist being bull rushed or tripped while standing on the ground.

ability.name: Stonecunning
ability.description: +2 racial bonus on Search checks to notice unusual stonework. Passive search within 10 ft. Can intuit depth underground.

ability.name: Naturally Psionic
ability.description: Gain 3 bonus power points at 1st level. Does not grant manifesting.

ability.name: Dodge Giants
ability.description: +4 dodge bonus to Armor Class against monsters of the giant type.

ability.name: Light Sensitivity (Ex)
ability.description: Dazzled in sunlight or within the radius of a daylight spell.

ability.name: Appraise (Stone/Metal)
ability.description: +2 racial bonus on Appraise checks related to stone or metal items.

ability.name: Craft (Stone/Metal)
ability.description: +2 racial bonus on Craft checks related to stone or metal.

name: Elan
description: Medium aberration. Formerly-humanoid beings sustained by psionic energy. Immune to humanoid-targeting spells. LA +0.

ability.name: Naturally Psionic
ability.description: Gain 2 bonus power points at 1st level. Does not grant manifesting.

ability.name: Resistance (Su)
ability.description: Immediate action, spend 1 power point: +4 racial bonus on saving throws until the beginning of the elan's next action.

ability.name: Resilience (Su)
ability.description: Immediate action, spend power points to reduce incoming damage by 2 HP per 1 PP spent.

ability.name: Repletion (Su)
ability.description: Spend 1 power point to forgo the need for food or water for 24 hours.

name: Half-Giant
description: Medium giant with powerful build, low-light vision, fire resistance bonus, and psionic stomp. LA +1.

ability.name: Low-Light Vision
ability.description: A half-giant can see twice as far as a human in starlight, moonlight, torchlight, and similar conditions of poor illumination, retaining color and detail.

ability.name: Fire Acclimated
ability.description: +2 racial bonus on saving throws against all fire spells and effects.

ability.name: Powerful Build
ability.description: Treated as one size larger for size modifiers in opposed checks (grapple, bull rush, trip), for being targeted by size-based special attacks, and for using weapons one size larger. Space and reach are unchanged.

ability.name: Naturally Psionic
ability.description: Gain 2 bonus power points at 1st level. Does not grant manifesting.

name: Maenad
description: Medium humanoid with sonic psi-like abilities and a rage-based physical outburst. LA +0.

ability.name: Naturally Psionic
ability.description: Gain 2 bonus power points at 1st level. Does not grant manifesting.

ability.name: Outburst (Ex)
ability.description: 1/day for up to 4 rounds: -2 Intelligence and Wisdom, +2 Strength. Subjugates mentality for raw physical power.

name: Xeph
description: Medium humanoid with darkvision, innate psionic/magic resistance, and a 3/day burst of speed. LA +0.

ability.name: Darkvision 60 ft.
ability.description: Xephs can see in the dark up to 60 feet.

ability.name: Psionic/Magic Resistance
ability.description: +1 racial bonus on saving throws against powers, spells, and spell-like effects.

ability.name: Naturally Psionic
ability.description: Gain 1 bonus power point at 1st level. Does not grant manifesting.

ability.name: Burst (Su)
ability.description: 3/day competence bonus to base speed: +10 ft. (plus +10 ft. per four character levels beyond 1st, max +30 ft. at 9th level). Lasts 3 rounds.
